violation_type.title: 4 through 7 years of age, outgrown weight or height limit of seat and less than 4 feet, 9 inches in height or cannot be properly secured (26 TAC §744.3807(e)(3)(A))
violation_type.short_title: 4 through 7 years of age, outgrown weight or height limit of seat and less than 4 feet, 9 inches in height or cannot be properly secured
violation_type.typical_finding: Four 7 year old children, under the height of 4'9", rode the general purpose vehicle without the use of a booster seat.
